map.验证Whipple三联征以确诊真性低血糖，指导胰岛素瘤等低血糖症病因鉴别: Verify Whipple's triad to confirm true hypoglycemia, guiding differential diagnosis of causes such as insulinoma.
map.空腹或运动后低血糖发作的病因筛查。: Etiology screening for fasting or post-exercise hypoglycemia.
map.疑诊胰岛素瘤的初步判断（症状+生化+缓解）。: Initial judgment of suspected insulinoma (symptoms + biochemistry + relief).
map.非糖尿病人群自发性低血糖的鉴别（药物性 vs 器质性）。: Differentiate spontaneous hypoglycemia in non-diabetics (drug-induced vs organic).
map.：晨间意识不清 + 发作时血糖 2.2 mmol/L + 进食后迅速缓解：满足三: : Morning confusion + blood glucose 2.2 mmol/L at onset + rapid relief after eating: satisfies the triad, suggesting insulin-mediated hypoglycemia (possible insulinoma); confirm with 72-hour fasting test and insulin/C-peptide assay.
map.经典切点 2.8 mmol/L（有些指南用 3.0），但关键是症状与低血糖同时出: Classic cutoff 2.8 mmol/L (some guidelines 3.0), but key is symptoms coinciding with hypoglycemia and relief by glucose; individualize for elderly and diabetics.
map.72 小时饥饿试验见低血糖时胰岛素不适当升高（胰岛素/血糖比>0.3、C 肽不抑: 72-hour fast shows inappropriately high insulin at hypoglycemia (insulin/glucose >0.3, C-peptide not suppressed), then localize (contrast CT/MRI/80% octreotide scan).
